title: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
geometryBasis: Used the current named native building footprint and Flemish 1 metre DTM and DSM survey. Bronze chariots and stone roofline follow the institutional postcard, and the rooftop structures refer to the architect’s 2022 description.
sectionBasis: The archival postcard shows four free Corinthian columns, two engaged columns and paired flanking pilasters, lateral stepped windows, copper roofs and the twin rooftop statues with two horses. The 2022 work adds triangular north-facing daylight structures within the historic outline.
limitations: Street-side volumes and courtyard roof follow the present footprint, archival façade and current published roof description. Small sculptures, inscriptions, patina and roof glazing detail are representative.
The surface survey predates the 2022 reopening, so modern rooflight height and exact glass panels are estimated.
